text: Agile methodology is a modern approach to managing projects, particularly in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short, focused periods called sprints, which usually last two to four weeks. At the beginning of each sprint, they choose tasks from a prioritized list called the backlog. These tasks are often described as user stories, which explain a feature from the perspective of the end user, such as "As a customer, I want to reset my password." Every day, the team holds a brief standup meeting to discuss progress and any obstacles. This iterative development allows the team to adapt quickly to changes and deliver working parts of the product regularly, ensuring constant improvement.
